summary.text: Cedric Schnitzler is the Republican candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 95, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Jill Billings and independent Paul Weber.

paragraphs.text: Cedric Schnitzler was the Republican candidate for Wisconsin State Assembly District 95 in 2024, when incumbent Jill Billings defeated him in the November 5, 2024, general election.
He advanced from the Republican primary for the same seat on August 11, 2026, receiving 3,015 votes.
